info.title: UNIS Fulfillment Quotation API
info.summary: Customers, quotes, versions, rate sheets and charge-code mapback for UNIS warehouse services.
info.description:
Integration API for the UNIS Fulfillment quotation tool.

**Main objects** (full CRUD): `Customer`, `Quote`, the quote `Draft` and its per-charge `Selection`s,
catalog `Charge`s, `ChargeCodeMapRule`s and `Webhook`s.
**Versions** are immutable snapshots: create, read, restore. **History** is append-only.
**Computed resources** are read-only: rate lines, the customer rate sheet (proposal), the charge-code mapback,
setup gaps and version diffs.

### Charge-code mapback
Every rate line of a quote resolves to an existing billing-system charge code plus the system conditions to configure
(for example `HANDLING-0129` with `OFFLoad Type: Floor Loaded`, `Case Qty: 0-500`). Each line has a status:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `mapped` | The code exists and already uses every condition the line needs |
| `new-condition` | The code exists, but a condition the line needs is not configured on it today |
| `new-item` | No code exists yet; create the item in the billing system first (`suggestedName`) |

`POST /quotes/{quoteId}/versions` stores the mapback with the version. Pass `requireMapped=true`
to refuse a version that still has `new-condition` or `new-item` lines.

### Conventions
- JSON, UTF-8. Money is a decimal number in USD (`10.5` = $10.50). Percent rates are fractions (`0.2` = 20%).
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. IDs are opaque strings.
- Lists are paginated with `page` / `pageSize` and return a `Page` envelope.
- Updates support optimistic concurrency: send the `ETag` you read as `If-Match`; a stale value returns `412`.
- `POST` endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header; a retried request with the same key returns the original result.
- Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
- Catalog strings are English; pass `lang` (`en`, `zh`, `ja`, `es`) where a localized rendering is offered.

Status: the reference implementation is the web app (browser storage). This contract is the target for the shared backend;
the server URL below is a placeholder until it is deployed.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Companies a quote is prepared for.

tags.name: Quotes
tags.description: A quote per customer, with status and its draft and versions.

tags.name: Drafts
tags.description: The editable working copy of a quote (header + charge selections).

tags.description: Immutable snapshots of a draft, each with its charge-code mapback.

tags.description: Computed rate lines and the customer proposal.

tags.description: Resolution of rate lines to existing billing-system charge codes, and what must be set up first.

tags.description: Append-only activity log (views, versions, exports, status changes).

post.description: A new quote starts from the default template (the most common charges) unless `template` is `blank`.

patch.summary: Update quote status or draft header

put.description: Validated against the catalog (unit, driver and factor values must exist; units hidden by the show/hide rules are rejected unless `showAll` is true).

post.summary: Save the current draft as a new version
post.description:
Snapshots the draft and its charge-code mapback. With `requireMapped=true` the request fails with `409`
(body lists the setup items) while any rate line is `new-condition` or `new-item`.

409.description: Setup required before the version can be saved (only with requireMapped=true)

post.summary: Copy a version back into the draft

get.summary: Compare two versions, or a version with the draft

get.description:
Laid out like the UNIS Business Proposal template: sections in template order, same-price variants merged into one row,
factors shared by every row lifted into the service heading. Use `Accept` to choose the format.

Catalog options not yet supported by the billing system

409.description: A rule for this option already exists

422.description: Unknown charge, unit, driver or system code

parameters.name: inUse
parameters.description: Only codes invoiced in the current usage period.

201.description: Created (the signing secret is returned once)

post.description:
Sent as `POST` to the subscription URL with header `X-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC of the body with the subscription secret>`.
Retried with backoff for 24 hours until a 2xx response. `version.saved` carries the mapback summary so billing can act on setup items.

bearerAuth.description: SSO access token for users of the quotation tool.

versionQuery.name: version
versionQuery.description: Version number; omit for the current draft.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: ETag from the last read; required for updates.

ETag.description: Version tag of the resource for If-Match.

code.description: Customer code in the billing system.

CondSelection.description: A rate factor ("Does the rate differ by ...?").

values.description: Catalog values that get their own rate.

text.description: Free-text factors (e.g. title / brand), comma separated.

UnitSelection.description: A billing unit ("Charge per ...") and how it is priced.

driver.description: Price driver in guided mode (null = flat rate).

flatOtherwise.description: Rows the price driver does not apply to are priced flat instead of left out (e.g. palletized containers when pricing by case count).

price.description: Simple charges only; omitted = benchmark default.

units.description: Keyed by unit ID; a unit priced a second way uses `unitId#2`, `unitId#3`, ... (e.g. `case` flat and `case#2` by case weight).

prices.description: Builder rate cells: key `unitId|value|value...|col` (col = p, first, add) or `unitId|MIN|basis`; omitted cells use the benchmark.

draftChanged.description: Draft differs from the latest version.

unitKey.description: Instance key when a unit is priced more than one way (e.g. `case#2`); otherwise equals unitId.

col.description: p = rate, first / add = first and additional unit, min = minimum charge.

supported.description: The code already uses this condition today.

altCodes.description: Other system codes that bill the same service (another trigger or direction); configure the same rate there.

initialCode.description: Storage only: initial (at receipt) storage code next to the recurring code.

detail.description: Condition to add, or suggested item name.

calc.description: Only when range and incremental tiers use different codes.

keys.description: Condition names configured on this code today.

invoiceLines.description: Invoice lines in the current usage period.

type.description: group = service heading with sub rows below; min = minimum charge row.

codes.description: System codes that bill this charge.

units.description: Step 2 billing units with their step 3 drivers.

when.description: Shown only for these factor values.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret, returned only on create.
